items.title: Send these readings to your care team today
items.text: Your average blood sugar was 178.3 mg/dL, which is higher than the target. Contact your care team today to discuss your readings.

items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after dinner is linked to a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in blood sugar. Walking 10 to 19 minutes after dinner got most of the gain, with a rise 17.5 mg/dL smaller.

items.title: Keep meal times steady around your shifts
items.text: Since you work nights, traditional rules about late dinners don't apply to you. Keep your main meal at the same point in your waking day.
